critical_code_review_comments: server.py:486 — PATCH /awaits/{id} uses `if 'amount' in upd and upd['amount'] <= 0: upd['amount']=None` inside model_dump(exclude_none=True). Because exclude_none drops explicit None, amount=0 correctly reaches this branch. Behavior matches spec (amount 0 → null); a comment noting the intent would help future maintainers.

server.py:706-719 — /api/owners/{name} does an in-Python O(N) scan of all user awaits for each request. Fine at seed scale; consider a MongoDB aggregation grouped by owner_key when data volumes grow (e.g., >2000 items/user). Not blocking.
server.py:702 — Owners list sort key `-o['overdue'], -o['open'], -o['owed']` correctly matches the review spec (overdue desc → open desc → owed desc → name asc). Test asserts overdue+open ordering.
